svg.text: all parts are on the far side; dashed lines show them through the board
right half of the top edge; the cluster sits 1 mm left of its centre
a 2.8 mm hole below each dial centre shows the selected label
Control cluster preview, seen from the user side. Dials are 14 mm Alps RK10J11E0034 wheels, mounted face-down.
Faint numbers are the label ring on each dial face, hidden by the board.
The shutter switch is an Omron D2MQ hinge-lever microswitch lying flat; its lever rests 2 mm above the edge.
